domains.name: Branching Adventures
domains.promise: Members spend a play-money ticket on /adventure start to enter a branching narrative (dungeon, forest, ocean, space, or mountain), navigate a scene state machine one Discord button choice at a time, accumulate play-money coins and virtual loot along the way, and reach a success, partial, or death ending that pays out exactly what was earned — with a per-member daily limit and a single active run at a time, all inside the fake game economy and never touching real commerce.

controls.description: Master switch for adventures, persisted as guild_config.economy_adventures_enabled; when off, /adventure start replies that the feature is disabled and no session is created.
Play-money coin cost of one /adventure start, persisted as guild_config.economy_adventure_ticket_cost; debited atomically via economy_subtract_balance before the run begins.
How many adventures each member may start per UTC day, persisted as guild_config.economy_adventure_daily_limit; further starts are refused until the day rolls over.
Upper bound on scenes an adventure may traverse before it is forced to an ending, persisted as guild_config.economy_adventure_max_scenes.

defaults.rationale: Branching adventures are a flagship game-economy loop and ship on for the maximal out-of-box experience; owners can switch them off any time.
A modest play-coin ticket makes each run feel like a real-but-recoverable stake without gatekeeping casual players.
Three runs a day give quick early wins while a conservative cap keeps the loop from being farmed to death.
Ten scenes is a satisfying story arc that still resolves inside a single sitting.

permissions.action: Run /adventure start and make scene choices on their own run
permissions.enforcement: The /adventure command responds for every member; every scene button resolves the session by its id and mutates only the invoking member's own active session row.

permissions.actor: Dashboard user with owner or admin access to the guild
permissions.action: Edit adventure settings on the dashboard economy adventures page
permissions.enforcement: Dashboard session auth plus Supabase RLS restrict guild_config writes to authorized guild administrators.

permissions.action: Press the scene buttons on another member's in-progress adventure
permissions.enforcement: The button handler compares the session's user_id to the interacting member and refuses with a not-your-adventure reply; no code path advances another member's session.

messages.trigger: A member starts an adventure with a play-money ticket
messages.audience: The adventuring member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: Your {adventure-name} begins, {member-name} — {ticket-cost} play coins spent. Choose your path!

messages.trigger: An adventure reaches a success or partial ending
messages.surface: Channel embed updating the adventure message
messages.audience: The adventuring member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: You made it out, {member-name}! You banked {coin-total} play coins and {item-count} item(s).

messages.trigger: An adventure reaches a death ending
messages.surface: Channel embed updating the adventure message
messages.audience: The adventuring member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: The adventure claimed you, {member-name} — you escape empty-handed. A fresh ticket awaits when you're ready.

messages.trigger: A ticket debit succeeded but the adventure session could not be created
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: That adventure never got off the ground, {member-name} — your {ticket-cost} play coins are already back in your wallet.

messages.trigger: The adventures backend is temporarily unreachable when a member runs an adventure command
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: The story map is smudged right now, {member-name} — give it a moment and try again.

messages.trigger: An ending payout keeps failing after the run resolved
messages.defaultTemplate: Heads up: the {coin-total}-coin adventure payout to {member-name} failed and is queued for operator retry; nothing was double-paid and everything is logged.

values.description: The member has no active run in this guild; /adventure start begins one when under the daily limit.
An active session sits at a scene, its current_scene_id persisted, awaiting the member's next button choice.
The run reached a success or partial ending; collected play coins and loot were paid out exactly once.
The run reached a death ending; the session is closed and no reward is paid.
The run ended but the play-money payout failed; the session is marked payout_failed with the earned amount preserved for operator retry.
Adventures disabled by configuration; /adventure start explains the feature is off and no session is created.

transitions.trigger: Member runs /adventure start with sufficient play-money balance and under the daily limit
transitions.expectedEffect: Exactly one ticket debit occurs via economy_subtract_balance and one active session row is created at scene zero; the partial unique index blocks any second concurrent active session.

transitions.trigger: The member presses a scene choice button
transitions.expectedEffect: current_scene_id moves to the chosen next scene exactly once and accumulated loot and play-coin currency are recorded on the session; re-pressing a stale button is a no-op.

transitions.trigger: A choice leads to a success or partial ending scene
transitions.expectedEffect: The session is marked completed and the earned play coins and loot items are paid out exactly once via economy_add_balance and economy_upsert_inventory.

transitions.trigger: A choice leads to a death ending scene
transitions.expectedEffect: The session is marked failed, collected currency and loot are zeroed, and no play-money payout is made.

transitions.trigger: economy_add_balance errors while paying out a resolved ending
transitions.expectedEffect: The session is marked payout_failed with the earned amount preserved, the member is told the payout is delayed rather than shown false success, and the amount is queued for operator retry under one idempotency key.

transitions.trigger: An operator retries the queued adventure payout after the transient fault clears
transitions.expectedEffect: Exactly one payout lands for the recorded amount and the session flips to completed; the ticket is never re-charged.

transitions.trigger: Owner turns adventures-enabled off on the dashboard
transitions.expectedEffect: /adventure start replies with the disabled explanation; existing session and scene rows are preserved untouched.
Members can start adventures again with all prior adventure and scene definitions intact.

failures.trigger: The play-money ticket debit succeeds but the economy_adventure_sessions insert fails or hits the active-session unique violation
failures.expectedBehavior: The ticket is refunded exactly once through economy_add_balance, the member sees the refund confirmation, and no orphan session row exists.

failures.trigger: economy_add_balance fails after the session was marked ended with earned play coins
failures.expectedBehavior: The session is marked payout_failed with the earned amount preserved, the completion embed plainly flags the delayed payout instead of pretending success, the payout is queued for operator retry under one idempotency key, and no loot or coins are double-granted.

failures.trigger: Supabase is unreachable when a member runs an adventure command
failures.expectedBehavior: The command replies with the branded adventures-unavailable message, no ticket is debited and no session is created; after the dependency recovers a fresh /adventure start debits exactly once and begins normally.

evidence.observer: Discord observer client joined to the primary test guild
evidence.expectedObservation: Adventure behavior contracted here is directly observed working in the live test guild: /adventure start debits a play-money ticket and posts scene zero, scene buttons advance the narrative one choice at a time, and success, partial, and death endings pay out exactly what was earned in play-money coins and loot.

evidence.observer: Supabase service-role SQL probe paired with anon and second-guild RLS probe clients
evidence.expectedObservation: The economy_adventures, economy_adventure_scenes, economy_adventure_sessions, economy_wallets, and guild_config rows enforce guild-scoped row-level security: the service role sees scenario rows while anon and cross-guild clients see none.

evidence.observer: Audit-log table reader using the service role
evidence.expectedObservation: Every state change in this domain lands exactly one append-only audit row with actor, guild, and correlation id; anonymization, never deletion, is the only mutation observed.

evidence.observer: Owner alert channel observer in the primary test guild
evidence.expectedObservation: This domain's failure branches raise exactly one owner alert carrying a human-readable reason and remediation hint; happy paths raise none.

evidence.observer: Embed and message snapshot inspector comparing captures against the configured brand kit
evidence.expectedObservation: Captured embeds and messages for this domain match the owner's white-label brand kit and configured voice preset, including the subtle powered-by-SomniBot attribution.

evidence.observer: Event re-delivery harness with a duplicate detector over messages, grants, and balance mutations
evidence.expectedObservation: Replaying recorded triggers for this domain against the live stack leaves end state unchanged: no duplicate play-money ticket debits, no double scene advances, and no double ending payouts.

evidence.observer: Post-run resource sweeper diffing run-prefixed inventory before and after the suite
evidence.expectedObservation: After the suite a sweep of the test guilds and database finds no run-prefixed resources from this domain remaining anywhere.

All adventure rows touched by this scenario carry the test guild id; a service-role probe sees the expected rows while anon and second-guild clients read zero of them.
Append-only audit rows capture each adventure action in this scenario with actor id, guild id, and the run-prefixed correlation id; no audit row is ever deleted.
The owner alert channel receives no alert on this scenario's happy path and exactly one reasoned alert whenever the scenario exercises a failure branch.
Every member-facing adventure surface in this scenario shows the owner's configured brand name, colors, and voice preset with the subtle powered-by-SomniBot attribution and zero stock-bot wording.
Re-delivering this scenario's triggering events yields no duplicate play-money ticket debits, scene advances, or ending payouts; persisted idempotency keys show exactly one effect per logical action.
